plugin.name: Clipboard History
plugin.description: Clipboard history manager with text, image, and file path support
settings.clearAll.confirm: Are you sure you want to clear all clipboard history? This cannot be undone.
settings.privacyNotice: hiven does not automatically detect passwords, tokens, or private keys. Pause recording, delete items, clear history, or disable image/file recording when needed.
surface.main.title: Clipboard History
filter.label: Type filter
state.emptyFrequent: No items meet the frequent threshold yet
preview.label: Preview
meta.label: Information
message.deleted.toast: Moved to Recently deleted; recoverable for 30 days
merge.instruction: Choose 1–{max} across searches. Copy combined text, compare two, or queue in order.
merge.emptySelection: Select items on the left, then arrange them here.
merge.minimum: Select at least {min} text items to preview.
merge.readFailed: Could not read all selected text. Your selection is kept. Retry, or remove the unavailable item.
merge.limit: You can select up to {max} text items.
merge.textOnly: Only text items can be selected.
compare.failed: Could not open comparison; an item may have changed or been deleted. Selection retained. Retry or replace an item.
compare.tooLarge: The two full texts exceed 1 MiB combined. Nothing was truncated. Replace an item.
edit.title: Edit history text
edit.description: Save replaces this history item. It does not change the clipboard. Cancel keeps the original text.
edit.error.missing: This history item was deleted or is unavailable. Your draft is kept.
edit.error.changed: This item changed elsewhere. Your draft is kept; cancel and reopen to load the latest text.
edit.error.tooLarge: The full text exceeds the history text size limit. Shorten it or change the limit in settings; nothing was truncated.
edit.error.duplicate: This text already exists in history. Your draft is kept; no item was overwritten.
edit.error.failed: Could not save the history item. Your draft is kept; retry or cancel.
queue.ready: Queue ready. Return to the target app; {shortcut} pastes one item at a time.
queue.startFailed: Could not start the queue. Your selection is kept. Reselect any changed or deleted item, then retry.
queue.tooLarge: The full texts exceed 1 MiB combined. Nothing was truncated. Remove an item and retry.
queue.statusFailed: Could not read queue status. Reopen History to retry.
queue.cancelFailed: Could not cancel the queue. Retry before using its shortcut.
queue.completed: All queued items have been pasted.
queue.progress: Next {position}/{total} · {remaining} remaining · {shortcut} in the target app
queue.failed: Item {position} was not delivered; {remaining} remain. Focus the intended target and press {shortcut} to retry.
queue.snapshot: Uses full text saved when added; later history edits do not change this queue.
queue.platformUnavailable: Sequential paste currently requires Linux X11. macOS, Windows and Wayland are not supported yet. Your selection is kept; the queue was not started.
queue.shortcutConflict: {shortcut} could not be registered; another shortcut may already use it. Your selection is kept. Resolve the conflict and retry.
queue.platformHint: Currently available on Linux X11 only.
merge.copied: Full combined text copied. History and selection are unchanged.
merge.copyFailed: Could not copy all selected text. Your selection is kept; retry or remove unavailable items.
merge.tooLarge: Combined text exceeds 1 MiB (UTF-8). Nothing was copied or truncated; reduce the selection or separator.
retention.summary: New records: {months} calendar months · Favorites never expire automatically
retention.trashHint: Expired or manually deleted items can be restored for 30 days, then are permanently deleted automatically. Restore starts a new retention period.
retention.legacyConfirm: Include {count} protected earlier records in the {months}-calendar-month policy, starting today. Favorites remain exempt. Later expiration allows 30 days to restore, then permanently deletes automatically. Nothing is permanently deleted by this confirmation.
retention.legacyEnabled: Earlier records now follow the retention period starting today.
retention.restored: Restored. A new retention period starts today; favorite/protected status is preserved.
retention.failed: The operation failed. Your current view is kept; please retry.
error.retentionCleanup: History retention maintenance could not finish. It will retry; no successful cleanup is claimed.
retention.label: Retention
retention.favoriteExempt: Exempt from automatic expiry; manual deletion still applies
retention.protectedItem: Earlier record protected until explicitly included
retention.empty: No recoverable items. Active history is unchanged.
retention.recordingPaused: Recording paused · Browsing, recovery and scheduled cleanup remain available
